messages:
Alex M: Quick sketch — packaging stability plan for private (VPC/on-prem). Goal: reduce upgrade surface and give netops a single handshake flow. Draft ideas:
- Two lanes: 'slim-operator' (no host network changes) and 'bridge-mode' (netops config required).
- Rollout: canary -> batch -> global; auto-fallback to older operator on failure.
- Installer flags: --handshake-mode=relay|bridge, --preserve-egress-ip
Code:
```
installer --mode=slim-operator --handshake-mode=relay --preserve-egress-ip
```
Open Qs: k8s versions, ipam assumptions, rollback windows. Thoughts?

Priya S: Love two lanes. Need explicit matrix for customer-managed networking: static-egress vs nat-relay vs full-peering. Can we provide a 'dry-run' probe that validates BGP/peering before cutover? Also add required RBAC expectations in docs.

Mateo: Dry-run probe = yes. Implementation: operator will run net-check job that produces a small JSON report. Sample output:
```
net-check: PASS
egress-ip: preserved
bgp: missing (action: peering request)
```
We should store that report in preflight buckets and surface it in console.

Sam (eng): Question: upgrade path for operator changes that touch iptables/host routes. Plan for 'no-host-mod' policy? If not possible, we need explicit customer approval flows in console (checkbox + audit log).

Nora (netops): Netops wants: 1) clear list of required firewall rules; 2) deterministic egress IPs for auditors; 3) rollback plan that preserves customer NAT. Bridge-mode must not change BGP attributes without explicit netops sign-off.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary job started - installer/smoke v0.23 on staging

Alex M: Agreed on docs + preflight report. Propose API 'handshake-status' that returns PASS/WARN/FAIL and list of fixes. We'll add to console and CLI.

Priya S: SLA/launch criteria suggestion:
- preflight PASS on 3 pilot customers (different network topologies)
- automated rollback < 10m for 95% of upgrades
- observability: net-check detail in console + traceable upgrade spans
If we hit these, mark GA.

Mateo: Action items:
- [Alex] sketch handshake API + CLI (ETA 1w)
- [Sam] define 'no-host-mod' operator gate and fallback (ETA 2w)
- [Nora] produce firewall + egress doc (ETA 1w)
- [Priya] draft launch criteria page (ETA 3d)
I'll implement net-check job after Alex pushes the API prototype.

Alex M: Cool. I'll push a WIP doc to /docs/private/handshake.md and ping infra. Also want a tiny demo script for field to run:
```
curl -sS https://our-installer/check?token=... | jq .
```
Will follow up with Field next Tue.

Sam (eng): :thumbsup: I'll block time. Also let's capture metric: 'handshake-failures per 100 installs' as an SLO and add alert at 3% failure rate.

Nora (netops): :raised_hands: thanks. One ask: add an explicit 'preserve-egress-ip' toggle default false and document security implications.

Alex M: Noted. I'll make toggle explicit and default to false. Ending notes: keep the lanes narrow; prefer conservative defaults for field customers. Ping me if you need add'l detail.
